summary: Solid workflow and script; follows CI/CD and Bash conventions well. Issues: (1) Workflow references fixtures (config/license-policy.conf, fixtures/license-db.txt, fixtures/{requirements.txt|package.json}) that aren't shown in deliverable—if missing, jobs fail at file-existence checks (lines ~62-70 of workflow); (2) sed regex at workflow line 99 uses -E (extended), correctly, but depends on exact Summary format from script line ~344—fragile if tweaked; (3) No act-result.txt artifact shown (required per task); (4) Test file and fixtures not provided, blocking full verification. Script itself is well-designed: proper error exit codes, mocked license lookup, format-agnostic parsing, defensive policy loading. Workflow is least-privilege (contents: read), uses v4 actions, idempotent. Both would ship once fixtures are confirmed committed and in correct format.
